name: targeted-fix
architecture: Neural Orchestra v5 Contract-First Vertical Slicing
description: Fast-path surgical bug fix and hotfix workflow: Skeleton Triage -> Single Vertical Fix -> Shift-Left Gate -> QA Regression Check.

phases.name: Target File Skeleton Extraction & Triage
phases.instructions: Run node .agents/bin/extract-skeleton.mjs <target-files> to extract exact type signatures without loading implementation bloat. Isolate root cause.

phases.name: Surgical Vertical Fix Execution
phases.instructions: Owning engineer implements fix and adds regression test. Must run node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs locally before submitting.

phases.name: Zero-Token Deterministic Quality Gate
phases.instructions: Run node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs. If failed, map-failures and dispatch back (max 3 retries).

phases.name: Regression Test & Git Diff Sign-Off
phases.instructions: Run affected test suite, verify fix in isolation, and confirm no side-effects in git diff.
